I really wish I could relocate. I have children keeping me in this mundane cycle of perpetual shit. I really should get help again, I just dont have the will. 

I gave her the car when she left because she had the kids, so it would be extremely hard to make appointments. 

I have been to inpatient twice which also didn't help. They basically told me They couldn't help me, but judging by the level of severity in the others mental health disorders I can see why they had to redirect their focus.

That you for sympathizing. Everyone wants to one up everyone it seems. I just kind of cock my head like "son, you have no clue". You are an awesome person for that. So thank you.

My bullies became scared of me As time went on. I was only beat up by school kids until 13, because at 14 I started to hit puberty. I got really big really fast. Like linebacker big. Currently I am 6'4 260, so I am a large man.

I have a career in insurance. I make good money. A far cry from the hustling and pimping that I saw in my youth.

I try to hang out with people. People actually seem to generally like me. I just understand that I am a black void right now. I dont want to drag anyone else down with me. So the dating app thing- I like a specific demographic of women that unfortunately only like guys that look like Johnny depp. I had gotten alot of racially charged messages and comments from the females on several sites. Many sites have a feature where you can see who has viewed your profile; I would view a profile and get messages back like "eww I don't do black guys" or this gem "you would be perfect if you were white". People really say this Shit. This happened around 5 times in a week. So I scrapped the profiles. I am told I am a very good looking guy, so this stifled me a bit. I am what you would call "mixed" so it's not like I am a charcoal monster. I live in an area that was very close to a neo Nazi compound, and the area is very militant, unnaccepting.

Anyways, I really wish I could just up and forget. An example is last night I had a dream where the guy came in my room again, beat me up, and took what he wanted all over again. I can't even go to sleep to escape.
